definitions.explanation: The act of putting or placing something into something else. Used for physical insertion, as well as inserting text, images, or scenes into a document, film, or other work.

examples.japanese: カードを{挿入|そうにゅう}してください。
{文章|ぶんしょう}に{画像|がぞう}を{挿入|そうにゅう}する。
examples.english: To insert an image into a document.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}の{途中|とちゅう}に{過去|かこ}の{回想|かいそう}シーンが{挿入|そうにゅう}されている。
examples.english: A flashback scene is inserted partway through the film.

notes:
USAGE:
{挿入|そうにゅう} is a formal, technical word. In everyday computing, it is used for inserting text, images, or other elements (the "Insert" function). In film and literature, {挿入|そうにゅう}{歌|か} refers to an insert song (a song played during a scene).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {挿入|そうにゅう}{歌|か}: insert song (in film/anime)
- {挿入|そうにゅう}{口|ぐち}: insertion slot
- カードを{挿入|そうにゅう}する: to insert a card
- {画像|がぞう}を{挿入|そうにゅう}する: to insert an image
- {挿入|そうにゅう}キー: Insert key (on keyboard)
